verdict.rationale: RingCentral documents call routing it provides itself: call handling rules and configurations, call forwarding targets, Call Queues routing to teams, and an AI Receptionist that answers and routes calls. That covers routing callers to teams. However, nothing in the evidence explicitly describes a keypad-driven auto-attendant/IVR menu ("press 1 for sales"), and the community mention of phone menus is only indirect. Missing for 10: explicit IVR/auto-attendant menu-builder documentation, DTMF key-to-destination mapping, and hands-on corroboration of building a menu.
